approvals.verbatim_excerpt: Погоджую абсолютно всі покращення і запропоновані доповнення. Реалізуй, онови навичку, дай файли і інструкцію для онови codex

decisions.A: Full C1 for each completed concept; C0 only preliminary sketches; full T for selected development
decisions.B: Authored/hybrid allowed with reason; meaningful variety first
decisions.C: Functional paid sets may give transparent measured time/options/power advantage when appropriate; competitive rules separate
decisions.D: Deterministic paid purchases default; earned RNG transparent; paid RNG separate explicit decision
decisions.E: No hidden adaptive difficulty by success or purchases by default; progression and pacing separate; transparent optional assists
decisions.F: Online/social/backend conditional per game; no mandatory new network/services/recurring cost without project decision

preserve: 60 FPS target with measured device evidence
